summary: The preacher argues that nighttime prayer—and the accompanying state of watchfulness—is far more powerful than daytime prayer. He claims the Bible commands believers to watch, which he interprets as praying at night, and cites Jesus as an example who prayed all night. By encouraging listeners to keep quiet hours awake—typically from evening to the early morning—he suggests this will strengthen their faith over time. He urges listeners to commit to unbroken nighttime vigils at least a couple of times a week, promising miraculous outcomes after sustained practice.
